texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: II.16.1. Suspension by the contractor
texts.text: II.16.1. Suspension by the contractor

texts.label: text
texts.orig: If  the  contractor  is  affected  by force  majeure, it  may  suspend  the performance  of  the contract .
texts.text: If  the  contractor  is  affected  by force  majeure, it  may  suspend  the performance  of  the contract .

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The  contractor  must  immediately  notify  the  contracting  authority  about  the  suspension. The  notification  must  include  a  description  of  the  force  majeure  and  state  when  the contractor expects to resume the performance of the contract.
texts.text: The  contractor  must  immediately  notify  the  contracting  authority  about  the  suspension. The  notification  must  include  a  description  of  the  force  majeure  and  state  when  the contractor expects to resume the performance of the contract.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The  contractor  must notify the  contracting  authority  as  soon  as  it  is  able  to  resume performance of the contract,  unless the contracting authority has already terminated the contract.
texts.text: The  contractor  must notify the  contracting  authority  as  soon  as  it  is  able  to  resume performance of the contract,  unless the contracting authority has already terminated the contract.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: II.16.2. Suspension by the contracting authority
texts.text: II.16.2. Suspension by the contracting authority

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The contracting authority may suspend the performance of the contrac t or any part of it:
texts.text: The contracting authority may suspend the performance of the contrac t or any part of it:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: (a) if  the  procedure  for  awarding  the  contract  or  the performance  of  the  contract proves to have been subject to substantial errors, irregularities or fraud ;
texts.text: (a) if  the  procedure  for  awarding  the  contract  or  the performance  of  the  contract proves to have been subject to substantial errors, irregularities or fraud ;

texts.label: text
texts.orig: (b) in order to verify whether the presumed substantial errors, irregularities or fraud have actually occurred.
texts.text: (b) in order to verify whether the presumed substantial errors, irregularities or fraud have actually occurred.
